name: io.logto.sdk.android.auth.logto.LogtoWebViewAuthActivity
description: In Logto Android SDK versions that use embedded sign-in, this screen displays the authorization page in an in-app web view and supports the SDK web-based social sign-in flow. Closing it cancels the pending sign-in.
disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through the embedded Logto page in app versions that use this flow.
